output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Howling in the Hills","Giver":"Adrianne Avenicci","Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","damage Wolf","goto Whiterun Hold","report Adrianne Avenicci"]}}
description: Adrianne Avenicci's supply lines are being threatened by a pack of unusually aggressive wolves prowling the roads just outside the city walls. She needs someone to thin their numbers.
hook: Can you believe it? Wolves, this close to the walls! My supplier refuses to make the trip until someone deals with those beasts. You look capable. How about it?

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Missing Shipment","Giver":"Belethor","Actions":["steal Silver Ring from Brenuin","goto Whiterun Hold","give Silver Ring to Belethor"]}}
description: Belethor is furious. A silver ring he had set aside for a special client has vanished. He suspects that good-for-nothing beggar, Brenuin, of 'finding' it. He wants it back, no questions asked.
hook: Everything's for sale, my friend! Everything! ...Except my personal inventory. Someone's lifted a silver ring right from under my nose. I have a feeling that layabout Brenuin is wearing a bit more finery than usual. Get it back for me, and there's a finder's fee in it for you.

input: {"Factions":{"The Companions":{"Name":"The Companions","NameDefinitive":"the Companions","DefaultLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":15}],"Members":["Kodlak Whitemane","Aela the Huntress","Farkas","Vilkas","Skjor","Lydia"],"FactionLog":[{"Originator":"The Companions","Type":"GuardEntity","Target":["Whiterun Hold"],"For":"The Companions"}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","NameDefinitive":"the Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"]}},"Player":{"FactionRelations":[{"Target":"The Companions","Favorability":15}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Watch the Walls","Giver":"The Companions","Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","defend Whiterun Hold"]}}
description: The Companions have been contracted to bolster Whiterun's guard for a night. There are rumors of a bandit raid, and they need extra eyes on the main gate.
hook: Whelp, you've shown you can swing a blade. But can you stand a post? We've got a contract to help guard the city tonight. It's boring work, but it pays. Stand by the main gate and make sure nothing ugly gets in.

input: {"NPCs":{"Jarl Balgruuf":{"Name":"Jarl Balgruuf","NamePossessive":"Jarl Balgruuf's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Jarl","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":15},{"Target":"The Silver Hand","Favorability":-15}]}},"Factions":{"The Silver Hand":{"Name":"The Silver Hand","NameDefinitive":"the Silver Hand","DefaultLocation":"Markarth Depths","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":-15}]}},"Locations":{"Markarth Depths":{"Name":"Markarth Depths","Enemies":["Falmer","Chaurus","Forsworn"],"Resources":["Iron Ore","Gold Septim"]}},"Player":{"FactionRelations":[{"Target":"The Silver Hand","Favorability":-15}],"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Jarl Balgruuf","Favorability":15}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Rude Awakening","Giver":"Jarl Balgruuf","Actions":["goto Markarth Depths","damage The Silver Hand"]}}
description: Jarl Balgruuf has received word that a group of Silver Hand mercenaries are causing trouble near the border of his hold, harassing travelers. He wants you to send them a clear message to stay out of his territory.
hook: My scouts tell me those Silver Hand brutes are getting bold, pressing into my lands. I don't have the men to spare for a full expedition, but one capable warrior could... discourage them. Break their morale, and they'll think twice about returning.

input: {"NPCs":{"Brynjolf":{"Name":"Brynjolf","NamePossessive":"Brynjolf's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Riften Docks","CurrentLocation":"Riften Docks","Faction":"The Thieves Guild","Role":"Thief","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":35}]},"Elenwen":{"Name":"Elenwen","NamePossessive":"Elenwen's","Species":"Elf","HomeLocation":"Solitude Arch","CurrentLocation":"Solitude Arch","Role":"Noble","OwnedItems":{"Elven Bow":1,"Gold Septim":5000,"Silver Ring":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":-30}]}},"Items":{"Elven Bow":{"Type":"Weapon","Name":"Elven Bow","NameSingular":"Elven Bow","IndefiniteArticle":"an"}},"Locations":{"Solitude Arch":{"Name":"Solitude Arch","Enemies":["Wolf","Vampire","Skeleton"]},"Riften Docks":{"Name":"Riften Docks","Enemies":["Skeever","Bandit","Frostbite Spider"]}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Brynjolf","Favorability":35},{"Target":"Elenwen","Favorability":-30}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Taste for the Finer Things","Giver":"Brynjolf","Actions":["goto Solitude Arch","steal Elven Bow from Elenwen","goto Riften Docks","give Elven Bow to Brynjolf"]}}
description: Brynjolf has his eye on a beautiful Elven Bow in the possession of Elenwen, the Thalmor Ambassador in Solitude. He's not interested in its combat value, but its resale value. He needs a skilled hand to acquire it for the Guild.
hook: I've heard some interesting whispers about you, lad/lass. I have a little... procurement job. An Elven Bow, up in Solitude, belongs to a pointy-eared noble. It's just gathering dust. Let's put it to better use, shall we?

input: {"NPCs":{"Aela the Huntress":{"Name":"Aela the Huntress","NamePossessive":"Aela the Huntress's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Faction":"The Companions","Role":"Ranger","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":20},{"Target":"The Silver Hand","Favorability":-50}],"NPCLog":[{"Originator":"The Silver Hand","Type":"Ambush","Target":["Skjor"],"For":"Aela the Huntress"}]}},"Factions":{"The Silver Hand":{"Name":"The Silver Hand","DefaultLocation":"Markarth Depths","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":-15},{"Target":"The Companions","Favorability":-50}]}},"Locations":{"Markarth Depths":{"Name":"Markarth Depths","Enemies":["Falmer","Chaurus","Forsworn"]}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Aela the Huntress","Favorability":20}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"An Eye for an Eye","Giver":"Aela the Huntress","Actions":["goto Markarth Depths","kill The Silver Hand","goto Whiterun Hold","report Aela the Huntress"]}}
description: Aela has identified a high-ranking Silver Hand leader hiding out in the depths of Markarth. This is the one who ordered the raid that wounded Skjor. Aela wants revenge, and she trusts you to deliver it.
hook: My blood is boiling. We've found him. The cur who leads the Silver Hand dogs in the Reach. He's holed up in some old dwarven ruin. I'd go myself, but Kodlak wants me here. You've earned my trust. Take his head. Make sure he knows it was a Companion who sent you to oblivion.

input: {"NPCs":{"Farengar Secret-Fire":{"Name":"Farengar Secret-Fire","NamePossessive":"Farengar Secret-Fire's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Wizard","OwnedItems":{"Grand Soul Gem":2,"Magicka Potion":5,"Staff of Frostbite":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]}},"Locations":{"Bleak Falls Barrow":{"Name":"Bleak Falls Barrow","Enemies":["Draugr","Frostbite Spider","Skeleton"],"Resources":["Gold Septim","Daedric Artifact Shard"]}},"Enemies":{"Draugr":{"Name":"Draugr","Loot":["Gold Septim","Iron Sword"],"NamePlural":"Draugr"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Farengar Secret-Fire","Favorability":5}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Clearing the Barrow","Giver":"Farengar Secret-Fire","Actions":["goto Bleak Falls Barrow","damage Draugr","goto Whiterun Hold","report Farengar Secret-Fire"]}}
description: Farengar is trying to study the ancient Nord burial site of Bleak Falls Barrow, but the Draugr within are too restless for him to get any real work done. He wants you to go and 'pacify' the primary chamber.
hook: Ah, yes. I have a task that requires a more... pragmatic touch. Bleak Falls Barrow is teeming with the dead. I need to study the wall carvings in the main hall, but I can't concentrate with all that shuffling and groaning. Clear them out, and I can finally get some work done.

input: {"NPCs":{"Camilla Valerius":{"Name":"Camilla Valerius","NamePossessive":"Camilla Valerius's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Morthal Swamp","CurrentLocation":"Morthal Swamp","Role":"Merchant","OwnedItems":{"Silver Ring":1,"Gold Septim":50},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Sven","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Faendal","Favorability":15}]},"Sven":{"Name":"Sven","NamePossessive":"Sven's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Morthal Swamp","CurrentLocation":"Morthal Swamp","Role":"Bard","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Camilla Valerius","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Faendal","Favorability":-10}]}},"Items":{"Silver Ring":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Silver Ring","NameSingular":"Silver Ring"}},"Locations":{"Morthal Swamp":{"Name":"Morthal Swamp","Enemies":["Frostbite Spider","Chaurus","Wisp"]}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Camilla Valerius","Favorability":10}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Family Heirloom","Giver":"Camilla Valerius","Actions":["goto Morthal Swamp","take Silver Ring from Sven","goto Morthal Swamp","give Silver Ring to Camilla Valerius"]}}
description: Camilla's prized silver ring, a gift from her late mother, has gone missing. She suspects one of her two jealous suitors, Sven or Faendal, might have taken it to frame the other or just to have a piece of her.
hook: Oh, you must help me! My mother's silver ring... it's just vanished from my dresser. I know it sounds awful to say, but with Sven and Faendal always bickering... could one of them have taken it? Please, I just want it back.

input: {"Factions":{"The College of Winterhold":{"Name":"The College of Winterhold","NameDefinitive":"the College of Winterhold","DefaultLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}],"Members":["Savos Aren","Mirabelle Ervine","Tolfdir","Faralda","J'zargo","Onmund","Brelyna Maryon","Enthir","Urag gro-Shub","Ancano"],"Treasury":{"Grand Soul Gem":12,"Staff of Frostbite":3,"Daedric Artifact Shard":2}}},"NPCs":{"Urag gro-Shub":{"Name":"Urag gro-Shub","NamePossessive":"Urag gro-Shub's","Species":"Orc","HomeLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","CurrentLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Faction":"The College of Winterhold","Role":"Wizard","OwnedItems":{"Staff of Frostbite":1,"Grand Soul Gem":4,"Magicka Potion":10}}},"Locations":{"Winterhold Ruins":{"Name":"Winterhold Ruins","Resources":["Grand Soul Gem","Staff of Frostbite"]}},"Items":{"Daedric Artifact Shard":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Daedric Artifact Shard","NameSingular":"Daedric Artifact Shard"}},"Player":{"FactionRelations":[{"Target":"The College of Winterhold","Favorability":5}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Arcaneum's Security","Giver":"The College of Winterhold","Actions":["goto Winterhold Ruins","defend Urag gro-Shub"]}}
description: Urag gro-Shub is expecting a rare and volatile delivery of Daedric Artifact Shards. He's worried that rogue elements, perhaps even someone within the College like Ancano, might try to intercept it. The College needs someone to stand guard while he catalogs the shards.
hook: This is a matter for someone with a strong arm and a closed mouth. Urag gro-Shub is receiving some highly sensitive materials. They are... unstable. We need you to ensure his work goes uninterrupted. No one gets in to see him. No one.

input: {"NPCs":{"Mikael":{"Name":"Mikael","NamePossessive":"Mikael's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Bard","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Carlotta Valentia","Favorability":-20}]},"Carlotta Valentia":{"Name":"Carlotta Valentia","NamePossessive":"Carlotta Valentia's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Merchant","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Mikael","Favorability":-20}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Mikael","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Carlotta Valentia","Favorability":10}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Skald's Satchel","Giver":"Mikael","Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","damage Carlotta Valentia"]}}
description: Mikael is convinced Carlotta Valentia is in love with him and is just playing hard to get. He wants you to 'persuade' her to be more receptive, by which he means rough her up a bit to make her realize she needs a strong protector like him.
hook: She resists, but I see the fire in her eyes. Carlotta, I mean. She just needs a little... nudge. A scare. Make her think the world is a dangerous place, and then she'll come running to my arms. Just rough her up a bit, nothing permanent. She'll thank me for it later.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Potent Brew","Giver":"Ingun Black-Briar","Actions":["goto Falkreath Graveyard","steal Black Soul Gem from Festus Krex","goto Riften Docks","give Black Soul Gem to Ingun Black-Briar"]}}
description: Ingun is trying to perfect a new, incredibly dangerous potion and needs a filled Black Soul Gem. She's heard the old wizard in the Dark Brotherhood, Festus Krex, has several. She doesn't care how you get it, she just needs the gem.
hook: I've almost perfected the formula. It will be magnificent. But the final ingredient... a filled Black Soul Gem... is proving elusive. There's an old fool with that ridiculous assassin's guild who has what I need. Acquire one for me. Quietly. My family has a reputation to uphold.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Silencing the Shadows","Giver":"Maven Black-Briar","Actions":["goto Falkreath Graveyard","kill Astrid","goto Riften Docks","report Maven Black-Briar"]}}
description: Maven sees the Dark Brotherhood as a rival to her own influence in the underworld. She's tired of their meddling. She wants you to prove your worth to her by eliminating their leader, Astrid. This is a test of ultimate loyalty.
hook: I have a... pest problem. A certain organization of murderers who think they operate above everyone else. Their leader, Astrid, has become a nuisance. Deal with her, permanently, and you'll have more than just septims from me. You'll have my gratitude. And my protection.

input: {"NPCs":{"Carlotta Valentia":{"Name":"Carlotta Valentia","NamePossessive":"Carlotta Valentia's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Merchant","OwnedItems":{"Bread":4,"Apple Pie":2,"Sweetroll":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10}]},"Lucia":{"Name":"Lucia","NamePossessive":"Lucia's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Beggar","OwnedItems":{"Sweetroll":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10}]}},"Items":{"Sweetroll":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Sweetroll","NameSingular":"Sweetroll","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Carlotta Valentia","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Lucia","Favorability":10}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Great Pie Heist","Giver":"Carlotta Valentia","Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","take Sweetroll from Lucia","goto Whiterun Hold","give Sweetroll to Carlotta Valentia"]}}
description: Carlotta's prized Sweetroll, which she was saving for her daughter, has gone missing. She saw little Lucia eyeing it earlier. It's a small matter, but it means the world to her.
hook: I know it's just a sweetroll, but I was saving it for my little girl. It was right here on the counter, and now it's gone. I saw that poor orphan girl, Lucia, looking at it with those big eyes... I can't bring myself to confront her. Could you just... get it back? I'll make you a fresh pie.

input: {"Factions":{"The Companions":{"Name":"The Companions","DefaultLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":15}],"Members":["Kodlak Whitemane","Aela the Huntress","Farkas","Vilkas","Skjor","Lydia"]}},"NPCs":{"Skjor":{"Name":"Skjor","NamePossessive":"Skjor's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Faction":"The Companions","Role":"Mercenary","OwnedItems":{"Iron Sword":1,"Health Potion":2,"Bear Pelt":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":15},{"Target":"The Companions","Favorability":45},{"Target":"The Silver Hand","Favorability":-45}],"NPCLog":[{"Originator":"The Silver Hand","Type":"Ambush","Target":["Skjor"],"For":"The Companions"}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant"]}},"Player":{"FactionRelations":[{"Target":"The Companions","Favorability":15}],"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Skjor","Favorability":15}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Shield-Brother's Vigil","Giver":"The Companions","Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","defend Skjor"]}}
description: Skjor is recovering from his wounds and is restless. He wants to patrol the perimeter of Jorrvaskr, but Vilkas worries he's too weak. He wants you to accompany Skjor, keeping a close eye on him without making it obvious you're babysitting.
hook: Skjor's pride is as wounded as his flesh. He insists on patrolling the mead hall tonight. I'm not about to stop him, but I also won't let him face a skeever alone in his state. Walk with him. Keep your blade sharp and your mouth shut. If trouble finds him, you be the shield he refuses to admit he needs.

input: {"NPCs":{"Sibbi Black-Briar":{"Name":"Sibbi Black-Briar","NamePossessive":"Sibbi Black-Briar's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Riften Docks","CurrentLocation":"Riften Docks","Faction":"The Thieves Guild","Role":"Thief","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":200,"Lockpick":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":-5}]},"Sigrid":{"Name":"Sigrid","NamePossessive":"Sigrid's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Dawnstar Quarry","CurrentLocation":"Dawnstar Quarry","Role":"Farmer","OwnedItems":{"Bread":3,"Apple Pie":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Alvor","Favorability":30}]},"Alvor":{"Name":"Alvor","NamePossessive":"Alvor's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Dawnstar Quarry","CurrentLocation":"Dawnstar Quarry","Role":"Blacksmith","Relations":[{"Target":"Sigrid","Favorability":30}]}},"Locations":{"Dawnstar Quarry":{"Name":"Dawnstar Quarry","Enemies":["Troll","Bandit"]}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Sibbi Black-Briar","Favorability":-5},{"Target":"Sigrid","Favorability":10}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Scare the Spouse","Giver":"Sibbi Black-Briar","Actions":["goto Dawnstar Quarry","damage Sigrid"]}}
description: Sibbi Black-Briar has his eye on Sigrid, the blacksmith's wife in Dawnstar. He believes if Alvor looks weak and unable to protect her, she'll leave him. He wants you to rough Alvor up a bit to make him seem pathetic.
hook: See, there's this woman up in Dawnstar. A real firecracker. Married to a lump of a blacksmith. I want her to see what a real man looks like. Go up there and give her husband a few new bruises. Make him look like the worthless slag he is. She'll come around.

input: {"NPCs":{"J'zargo":{"Name":"J'zargo","NamePossessive":"J'zargo's","Species":"Lizardfolk","HomeLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","CurrentLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Faction":"The College of Winterhold","Role":"Wizard","OwnedItems":{"Grand Soul Gem":2,"Magicka Potion":4},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10}]},"Enthir":{"Name":"Enthir","NamePossessive":"Enthir's","Species":"Elf","HomeLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","CurrentLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Faction":"The College of Winterhold","Role":"Merchant","OwnedItems":{"Daedric Artifact Shard":1,"Gold Septim":1000,"Black Soul Gem":2},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5},{"Target":"The Thieves Guild","Favorability":15}]}},"Items":{"Staff of Frostbite":{"Type":"Weapon","Name":"Staff of Frostbite","NameSingular":"Staff of Frostbite","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}},"Locations":{"Winterhold Ruins":{"Name":"Winterhold Ruins","Resources":["Grand Soul Gem","Staff of Frostbite"]}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"J'zargo","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Enthir","Favorability":5}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Spell Tome Procurement","Giver":"J'zargo","Actions":["goto Winterhold Ruins","steal Staff of Frostbite from Enthir","goto Winterhold Ruins","give Staff of Frostbite to J'zargo"]}}
description: J'zargo is convinced that Enthir has a Staff of Frostbite that could be a key to unlocking a new, powerful spell. Enthir refuses to sell it. J'zargo wants you to 'borrow' it for his research. He promises to return it... eventually.
hook: J'zargo has a theory. A magnificent, powerful theory. To prove it, J'zargo needs a specific staff. That shifty Elf, Enthir, has one, but he drives a hard bargain. One J'zargo cannot afford. Perhaps you could... acquire it for him? For the sake of magical discovery, of course.

input: {"NPCs":{"Ulfric Stormcloak":{"Name":"Ulfric Stormcloak","NamePossessive":"Ulfric Stormcloak's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Windhelm Slums","CurrentLocation":"Windhelm Slums","Role":"Jarl","OwnedItems":{"Iron Sword":1,"Health Potion":4,"Gold Septim":1000},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":0},{"Target":"General Tullius","Favorability":-40}]},"Legate Rikke":{"Name":"Legate Rikke","NamePossessive":"Legate Rikke's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Solitude Arch","CurrentLocation":"Solitude Arch","Role":"GuardCaptain","OwnedItems":{"Iron Sword":1,"Health Potion":3},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5},{"Target":"General Tullius","Favorability":35},{"Target":"Ulfric Stormcloak","Favorability":-30}]},"General Tullius":{"Name":"General Tullius","NamePossessive":"General Tullius's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Solitude Arch","CurrentLocation":"Solitude Arch","Role":"GuardCaptain","Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":0},{"Target":"Ulfric Stormcloak","Favorability":-40},{"Target":"Legate Rikke","Favorability":35}]}},"Locations":{"Solitude Arch":{"Name":"Solitude Arch","Enemies":["Wolf","Vampire","Skeleton"]},"Windhelm Slums":{"Name":"Windhelm Slums","Enemies":["Skeever","Bandit"]}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Ulfric Stormcloak","Favorability":0},{"Target":"Legate Rikke","Favorability":5},{"Target":"General Tullius","Favorability":0}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Butcher of Windhelm","Giver":"Ulfric Stormcloak","Actions":["goto Solitude Arch","kill Legate Rikke","goto Windhelm Slums","report Ulfric Stormcloak"]}}
description: Ulfric Stormcloak sees Legate Rikke as a traitor to Skyrim, a Nord who sold her soul to the Empire. He wants to make an example of her. He's asking you, a neutral party, to prove your mettle by assassinating her in the heart of Imperial territory.
hook: I see you have the fire of a true Nord in you, even if you haven't chosen a side. There is a traitor in Solitude. Legate Rikke. A Nord who bows to a foreign emperor. Kill her. Show the Empire that their boot-lickers are not safe, even in their own capital. Do this, and you will have the eternal gratitude of the true High King.

input: {"NPCs":{"Proventus Avenicci":{"Name":"Proventus Avenicci","NamePossessive":"Proventus Avenicci's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Noble","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":250,"Silver Ring":1,"Ale":2},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10},{"Target":"Jarl Balgruuf","Favorability":25}]},"Jarl Balgruuf":{"Name":"Jarl Balgruuf","Role":"Jarl","Relations":[{"Target":"Proventus Avenicci","Favorability":25}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold","Enemies":["Wolf","Bandit","Giant","Sabre Cat"]}},"Enemies":{"Sabre Cat":{"Name":"Sabre Cat","Loot":["Sabre Cat Pelt","Sabre Cat Tooth"],"NameSingular":"Sabre Cat","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Proventus Avenicci","Favorability":10}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Pelt for the Jarl","Giver":"Proventus Avenicci","Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","damage Sabre Cat","goto Whiterun Hold","report Proventus Avenicci"]}}
description: Jarl Balgruuf has been complaining that the throne room feels drafty. Proventus, ever the diplomat, wants to present him with a magnificent Sabre Cat pelt to use as a throw. The problem is, the only Sabre Cats around are particularly vicious.
hook: The Jarl's comfort is paramount to the smooth operation of this hold. He mentioned a draft. I was thinking a fine, warm Sabre Cat pelt would do the trick. You seem the sort who could handle one of those beasts. Bring me its pelt, and I'll make it worth your while.

description: Sven wants to join the Bard's College in Solitude but needs the tuition fee. He claims his rival, Faendal, stole his inheritance from his grandmother and that a valuable Elven Bow is rightfully his. He wants you to steal it back.
hook: My dreams are crushed, my friend! Faendal, that wood-elf scoundrel, tricked my poor, senile grandmother out of my inheritance. The only thing left of value is an Elven Bow he carries everywhere. It's rightfully mine! I need it to pay for my admission to the Bard's College. You must help me reclaim my future!

description: The Dark Brotherhood has accepted a very strange, very lucrative contract: to protect a Thalmor Ambassador from an unknown threat. Elenwen is expecting an assassination attempt during a diplomatic function at the Arch. The Brotherhood wants you to be an unseen shadow, stopping any attack.
hook: Sithis cares not from whom the blood flows, only that it does. And tonight, our coffers flow with gold to prevent that blood from being a high elf's. A client has paid handsomely to ensure Elenwen survives the night. You will be her guardian devil. Stay hidden. Stop any... uninvited guests. The irony is not lost on me.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Honorless Cur","Giver":"Vilkas","Actions":["goto Riften Docks","damage Mercer Frey"]}}
description: Vilkas has heard tales of Mercer Frey's treachery and his utter lack of honor. It makes his Nord blood boil. While he can't sanction an outright assassination, he wants someone to 'teach the thief a lesson' and show him that real warriors don't need to backstab.
hook: I hear things. About a man in Riften who leads a den of thieves. A man called Mercer Frey. No honor. No spine. Just a dagger in the dark. I'd like someone to show him what it feels like to face a real opponent, shield-to-face. Give him a few bruises to remember. Let him know the Companions are watching.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Rock and a Hard Place","Giver":"Alvor","Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","steal Corundum Ingot from Belethor","goto Dawnstar Quarry","give Corundum Ingot to Alvor"]}}
description: Alvor has a huge order from the Legion and has completely run out of Corundum Ingots. The only merchant with a stockpile is Belethor in Whiterun, but Belethor, knowing Alvor's desperation, is price-gouging him. Alvor, a proud man, refuses to pay the unfair price but is also too proud to steal it himself.
hook: I'm in a bind, friend. The Imperials want fifty new swords by next Fredas. And that swindler Belethor is charging triple for the corundum I need. I won't pay his blood money, but I can't let this contract fall through. I... I can't ask you to do anything untoward. But if a few ingots happened to find their way from his shop to my forge, I'd make sure you were properly compensated. No questions asked.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Emperor's Shadow","Giver":"General Tullius","Actions":["goto Windhelm Slums","kill Galmar Stone-Fist","goto Solitude Arch","report General Tullius"]}}
description: General Tullius knows that Ulfric's right hand, Galmar Stone-Fist, is the true military mind behind the Stormcloak rebellion. Eliminating him would cripple their war effort. He's asking you to go to Windhelm and kill Galmar, a mission of immense danger and reward.
hook: I'm a soldier. I fight battles, armies against armies. But this war will drag on for years unless we cut off the head of the snake. And I don't mean Ulfric. I mean his general, Galmar Stone-Fist. He's the brains. Kill him, and the Stormcloaks are just a mob. This isn't an order. It's a request from one pragmatist to another. Name your price.

input: {"NPCs":{"Ysolda":{"Name":"Ysolda","NamePossessive":"Ysolda's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Merchant","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":50,"Bread":2,"Apple Pie":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":10},{"Target":"The Thieves Guild","Favorability":10}]}},"Locations":{"Riften Docks":{"Name":"Riften Docks","Enemies":["Skeever","Bandit","Frostbite Spider"]},"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold"}},"Enemies":{"Skeever":{"Name":"Skeever","Loot":[],"NamePlural":"Skeevers","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Ysolda","Favorability":10}]}}

description: Ysolda has been trying to set up a new trade route with a caravan in Riften, but their warehouse is infested with Skeevers. The caravan master refuses to work until they're gone. She needs a strong arm to clear them out so her deal can go through.
hook: Oh, I was so close to a breakthrough! A new supplier in Riften, but his warehouse is crawling with skeevers. Filthy things. He's too scared to go in and get my merchandise. If you could clear them out, I could finally get my hands on those rare ingredients. I'll make it worth the... smell.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Love Letter","Giver":"Onmund","Actions":["goto Winterhold Ruins","steal Amulet of Mara from Brelyna Maryon","goto Winterhold Ruins","give Amulet of Mara to Onmund"]}}
description: Onmund is desperately in love with Brelyna Maryon but is too shy to tell her. He had an Amulet of Mara he was going to give her, but she found it and, thinking it was an interesting enchanted artifact for study, took it for her research. He's too embarrassed to ask for it back and wants you to retrieve it.
hook: By the Nine, this is mortifying. I... I had an Amulet of Mara. For Brelyna. But she saw me with it and asked to study the enchantment. Now it's in her quarters and I can't very well say 'Excuse me, I need that back so I can awkwardly ask you to marry me.' Could you just... get it back? Quietly? Pretend you're just curious about its properties?

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Jarl's Justice","Giver":"Irileth","Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","defend Jarl Balgruuf"]}}
description: Irileth has received credible intelligence of an assassination plot against Jarl Balgruuf during the upcoming public address. She can't be everywhere at once and needs a trusted, extra set of eyes in the crowd.
hook: Listen closely. There's a plot against the Jarl. During his speech tomorrow. I'll be on the stage, but I need someone in the crowd, someone with a warrior's instinct. Stand near the front. If anyone makes a move I can't see, you stop them. The Jarl's life is in your hands.

description: The Forsworn have been raiding farms on the outskirts of Whiterun Hold. The Jarl is slow to act, so the Companions have decided to take the initiative. They want you to go to the edge of the Reach and bloody the nose of a Forsworn war party to discourage further attacks.
hook: While the Jarls debate politics, our people suffer. The Forsworn think the plains are free for the taking. Let's teach them they're wrong. Head to the border of the Reach. Find one of their raiding parties. Don't need to wipe them out, just make them regret they ever left their hills.

description: Delvin has a special client who deals in rare magical goods. He knows that the Black-Briars, specifically Hemming, keep a small stash of filled Black Soul Gems for 'insurance.' He wants you to liberate one from Hemming's private quarters.
hook: Alright, lad/lass, got a high-roller job for ya. Top shelf stuff. The Black-Briars, they keep a few trinkets for a rainy day. I'm talking filled Black Soul Gems. Hemming, the dull one, he's got one in his room. Usually drunk. You could waltz in and waltz out. Get it for me, and you'll get a cut from a very profitable sale.

description: A powerful Hagraven has taken up residence in the Morthal Swamp and is terrorizing travelers and corrupting the local wildlife. Jarl Balgruuf, concerned about the stability of the neighboring hold, wants it gone. He trusts you with this dangerous task.
hook: A blight has fallen on Hjaalmarch. A Hagraven, a truly ancient and wicked one, has nested in the swamps. Idgrod's people are suffering. This isn't just a favor to a neighbor; a threat like that, left unchecked, will eventually become my problem. I need a champion to go into that mire and burn the witch out. You've proven you can handle yourself.

input: {"NPCs":{"Ingun Black-Briar":{"Name":"Ingun Black-Briar","NamePossessive":"Ingun Black-Briar's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Riften Docks","CurrentLocation":"Riften Docks","Faction":"The Thieves Guild","Role":"Apothecary","OwnedItems":{"Magicka Potion":5,"Health Potion":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]}},"Locations":{"Morthal Swamp":{"Name":"Morthal Swamp","Enemies":["Frostbite Spider","Chaurus","Wisp"]},"Riften Docks":{"Name":"Riften Docks"}},"Enemies":{"Frostbite Spider":{"Name":"Frostbite Spider","Loot":["Health Potion"],"NamePlural":"Frostbite Spiders","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Ingun Black-Briar","Favorability":5}]}}

description: Ingun needs fresh Frostbite Spider venom for a potion she's brewing. The spiders in the Rift are too weak, but she's heard the ones in the Morthal Swamp are particularly potent. She wants you to go and collect venom samples, which means getting it from the source the hard way.
hook: I require a reagent of... considerable potency. Frostbite Spider venom, specifically from the swamps of Hjaalmarch. The environment there makes their toxins uniquely virulent. I need you to 'harvest' some. Just get them to spit at you a few times and collect the residue. Simple, really.

description: Elenwen believes Mercer Frey, the leader of the Thieves Guild, is in possession of a Daedric Artifact Shard that she needs for Thalmor research. She can't officially sanction a raid on Riften. She wants you, a deniable asset, to steal it.
hook: We have reason to believe an individual in Riften, a man named Mercer Frey, has come into possession of an item of great interest to the Aldmeri Dominion. A shard of a Daedric artifact. Retrieving it through official channels would be... messy. You, however, could operate with a certain freedom. Acquire it, and you will be generously compensated. No one need ever know of our arrangement.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"Guarding the Guild","Giver":"The Thieves Guild","Actions":["goto Riften Docks","defend Brynjolf"]}}
description: Brynjolf is meeting a very dangerous contact in the Ratway. He expects it might be a trap. He wants you to hide nearby and ensure that if things go south, he walks out of there alive.
hook: Lad/Lass, I'm meeting a client tonight. The kind that makes my skin crawl. I don't trust him as far as I can spit. I need a shadow. Someone to watch my back. If I go down there and don't come back up in an hour, I expect you to come down and pull me out. Preferably with all my vital organs intact.

input: {"NPCs":{"Ulfberth War-Bear":{"Name":"Ulfberth War-Bear","NamePossessive":"Ulfberth War-Bear's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Merchant","OwnedItems":{"Iron Sword":1,"Bear Pelt":2,"Ale":5},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Adrianne Avenicci","Favorability":30}]},"Nazeem":{"Name":"Nazeem","NamePossessive":"Nazeem's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Noble","OwnedItems":{"Gold Septim":100,"Silver Ring":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":-5}]}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Ulfberth War-Bear","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Nazeem","Favorability":-5}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"A Nord's Pride","Giver":"Ulfberth War-Bear","Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","damage Nazeem"]}}
description: Ulfberth is tired of Nazeem's constant belittling of everyone in Whiterun, including his wife Adrianne. He wants someone to 'accidentally' trip and fall into Nazeem, preferably with a fist, just to shut him up for a few days.
hook: You hear that man? Walking around like he owns the cloud district. Bah. I'd love to plant my fist in his smug face, but it's bad for business. You, though. You could just... have a 'disagreement' with him. A little 'accident' behind the Bannered Mare. I'd be much obliged. Drinks are on me for a week.

input: {"NPCs":{"Ancano":{"Name":"Ancano","NamePossessive":"Ancano's","Species":"Elf","HomeLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","CurrentLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Faction":"The College of Winterhold","Role":"Wizard","OwnedItems":{"Staff of Frostbite":1,"Grand Soul Gem":5,"Magicka Potion":10},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":-10},{"Target":"Savos Aren","Favorability":-15}]},"Savos Aren":{"Name":"Savos Aren","NamePossessive":"Savos Aren's","Species":"Elf","HomeLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","CurrentLocation":"Winterhold Ruins","Faction":"The College of Winterhold","Role":"Wizard","OwnedItems":{"Staff of Frostbite":1,"Grand Soul Gem":3,"Magicka Potion":10},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Ancano","Favorability":-15}]}},"Items":{"Staff of Frostbite":{"Type":"Weapon","Name":"Staff of Frostbite","NameSingular":"Staff of Frostbite"}},"Locations":{"Winterhold Ruins":{"Name":"Winterhold Ruins"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Ancano","Favorability":-10},{"Target":"Savos Aren","Favorability":5}]}}

description: Ancano wants Savos Aren's personal Staff of Frostbite, which he believes contains a unique enchantment that can further his own research. He's too suspicious to do it himself, so he's trying to manipulate you into stealing it for him.
hook: The Arch-Mage... he clings to certain artifacts, hoarding knowledge that should be free for all. His personal staff, for instance. A crude implement, but the enchantment is quite unique. I need to study it. For the good of the College, of course. I'm sure a resourceful individual like yourself could find a way to borrow it. Discreetly.

description: This is it. Ulfric Stormcloak wants you to end the Civil War by killing General Tullius himself. He knows this is a monumental task, but he believes you are the only one who can get close enough to the General to succeed. This is a quest of legend.
hook: For years I've fought the Empire. Words, then steel. But one man stands between Skyrim and her freedom: General Tullius. He is the Empire's will made flesh. Kill him, and the Legion will crumble. You have walked between our worlds. You can go where my soldiers cannot. End this war. Be the hero Skyrim needs.

description: The lower, unused chambers of the College have become infested with Frostbite Spiders. Tolfdir is worried they'll eventually chew through the ancient stonework and damage some of the more delicate wards. He needs a few of the larger ones cleared out.
hook: Ah, yes, a small pest issue. We have a nest of rather large Frostbite Spiders in the old cistern. They're quite a nuisance, and I worry their venom might corrode the foundational wards. I'm far too busy with my own research, but perhaps you could go down and... encourage them to relocate? To the afterlife, preferably.

description: Brenuin is penniless and thirsty. He swears he saw Mikael drop a bottle of fine Ale behind the Bannered Mare, but he's too proud (and drunk) to go get it himself. He wants you to fetch it for him.
hook: Spare a coin for a poor old... Oh, it's you. Listen, I saw that poncy bard drop a whole bottle of good ale out back. It's just lying there. I'd get it myself, but my knees aren't what they used to be. And that guard keeps giving me the evil eye. Be a friend, grab it for me? I'll share a swig with ya.

description: Mirabelle is worried about the Arch-Mage. He's been acting strangely, spending hours staring into a specific magical anomaly in the Midden. She wants you to watch him from a distance and ensure nothing... happens. He's to be protected, but not to know he's being watched.
hook: I'm concerned about the Arch-Mage. He's been fixated on something in the Midden. It's not like him. I want you to follow him down there tonight. Stay hidden. Just watch. If the anomaly does anything... or if his mind seems to be... slipping... you are to ensure his safety and then report directly back to me. Do not let him know you are there.

description: Belethor is furious that Lucan Valerius in Riverwood is undercutting his prices on general goods. He wants you to go down there and make Lucan's shop look like a less attractive option by giving him a few bruises and 'encouraging' him to raise his prices.
hook: That backwater shopkeep in Riverwood, Lucan Valerius! He's bleeding me dry with his rock-bottom prices! It's... it's unsporting! I need you to go down there and have a 'word' with him. A firm word. Make him see the error of his ways. Nothing that'll kill him, just... make him think twice about his pricing strategy.

input: {"NPCs":{"Nazir":{"Name":"Nazir","NamePossessive":"Nazir's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Falkreath Graveyard","CurrentLocation":"Falkreath Graveyard","Faction":"The Dark Brotherhood","Role":"Thief","OwnedItems":{"Steel Dagger":1,"Gold Septim":100},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":15}]},"Festus Krex":{"Name":"Festus Krex","NamePossessive":"Festus Krex's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Falkreath Graveyard","CurrentLocation":"Falkreath Graveyard","Faction":"The Dark Brotherhood","Role":"Wizard","OwnedItems":{"Staff of Frostbite":1,"Grand Soul Gem":1,"Magicka Potion":4},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]}},"Factions":{"The Dark Brotherhood":{"Name":"The Dark Brotherhood","Treasury":{"Black Soul Gem":10}}},"Items":{"Black Soul Gem":{"Type":"Artifact","Name":"Black Soul Gem","NameSingular":"Black Soul Gem"}},"Locations":{"Falkreath Graveyard":{"Name":"Falkreath Graveyard","Resources":["Black Soul Gem","Grand Soul Gem"]}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Nazir","Favorability":15},{"Target":"Festus Krex","Favorability":5}]}}
output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Gem of Souls","Giver":"Nazir","Actions":["goto Falkreath Graveyard","steal Black Soul Gem from Festus Krex","goto Falkreath Graveyard","give Black Soul Gem to Nazir"]}}
description: Nazir wants a filled Black Soul Gem for an... unorthodox contract. The mark has a magical protection that can only be bypassed by the energy from a filled gem. Festus Krex hoards them, but Nazir needs one now and doesn't want to listen to the old man's lectures. He wants you to 'borrow' one.
hook: The old man has a thousand of the damned things, but will he lend me one? No. 'The Black Soul is not a toy, Nazir!' It's for a contract, you old fool. I don't have time for his moralizing. I need a filled Black Soul Gem. Festus has a satchel of them in his room. He's deaf as a post. You could take one and he'd never know. Until he counts them next year.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Butcher's Apprentice","Giver":"Astrid","Actions":["goto Whiterun Hold","kill Kodlak Whitemane","goto Falkreath Graveyard","report Astrid"]}}
description: Astrid wants to make a statement. She wants the leader of the Companions, the symbol of Nord honor, dead. This is a major contract, and she's giving it to you. Succeed, and you'll be a legend in the Brotherhood. Fail, and you'll be a ghost.
hook: The Companions. They think they're so pure. They put down rabid dogs and call themselves heroes. Their leader, Kodlak Whitemane, is a revered old fool. Kill him. Show Skyrim that even their 'honored heroes' are just meat for Sithis. This is your Black Sacrament. Do not fail me.

description: Gerdur needs a package delivered to a farm on the other side of the river, but the wolves have been more aggressive lately and she's afraid to make the trip alone. It's just a delivery, but the road is dangerous.
hook: Oh, it's good to see a friendly face. I need to get this package to my sister's farm, but those wolves have been howling up a storm all week. I'm not a fighter. Could you walk with me, or maybe just clear a path? It's just a short trip, but I'd feel safer with a blade nearby.

input: {"NPCs":{"Mikael":{"Name":"Mikael","NamePossessive":"Mikael's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Bard","OwnedItems":{"Ale":3,"Gold Septim":20},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]},"Heimskr":{"Name":"Heimskr","NamePossessive":"Heimskr's","Species":"Human","HomeLocation":"Whiterun Hold","CurrentLocation":"Whiterun Hold","Role":"Priest","OwnedItems":{"Bread":1},"Relations":[{"Target":"Dragonborn","Favorability":5}]}},"Items":{"Sweetroll":{"Type":"Food","Name":"Sweetroll","NameSingular":"Sweetroll","IndefiniteArticle":"a"}},"Locations":{"Whiterun Hold":{"Name":"Whiterun Hold"}},"Player":{"NPCRelations":[{"Target":"Mikael","Favorability":5},{"Target":"Heimskr","Favorability":5}]}}

description: Mikael is convinced that the crazy priest Heimskr stole his lucky pick, which was shaped like a sweetroll. He's too embarrassed to accuse a priest of Talos, so he wants you to just go into Heimskr's small shack and take anything that looks like a sweetroll.
hook: You'll think I'm mad. That crazy priest, Heimskr, the one who screams about Talos all day? He took my lucky lute pick. It's a family heirloom, carved from a petrified sweetroll! He must have thought it was real food. I can't be seen fighting a priest. Just go into his little hovel and look for anything sweetroll-shaped. My career depends on it!

description: Despite his abrasiveness, Ancano is the Thalmor's official advisor and a guest of the College. Savos Aren has received a warning that a rogue faction of mages might try to assassinate Ancano to cause a diplomatic incident. The College must protect him, no matter how much they despise him.
hook: This stays between us. There's a credible threat against Advisor Ancano's life. Yes, I know. I wouldn't mind if someone turned him into a newt, either. But if he dies on our grounds, the political fallout would destroy the College. You will be his personal guard tonight. Stay in his room. Make sure no one gets in. And try not to kill him yourself.

description: Maven Black-Briar's primary rival in the rare goods trade is Enthir at the College of Winterhold. She wants to remind him that his little operation is only allowed to exist because she permits it. A simple beating should send the message.
hook: That sniveling elf at the College, Enthir. He's been getting a bit too big for his britches, selling items that are in direct competition with my... associates. I want you to pay him a visit. Don't kill him. I'm not a barbarian. Just remind him of his place in the world. Use your fists, not a blade. He'll understand the message.

description: Jarl Balgruuf suspects Maven Black-Briar is using a Daedric Artifact Shard to enhance the potency of a new type of Skooma flooding his city. He needs the shard as evidence so he can finally put pressure on the Black-Briars. But it must be acquired without implicating Whiterun in the theft.
hook: This filth is poisoning my people. It's a new strain of skooma, and it's too potent to be alchemy alone. My court wizard suspects a Daedric artifact is involved. And I suspect Maven Black-Briar. I can't send my guards to Riften to search her home. It would start a war. But you... you could acquire this 'evidence' for me. Bring me that shard, and I can at least confront her with the truth.

description: Farengar is convinced that Enthir is sitting on a trove of ancient magical knowledge that rightfully belongs to a 'proper' scholar. He's jealous and frustrated by Enthir's refusal to share. He wants the wood elf eliminated so he can 'liberate' his collection.
hook: That fence, Enthir, up at the College. He sits on a dragon's hoard of rare tomes and artifacts, and he does *nothing* with them! He sells baubles to thieves! It's an insult to the very nature of magic. He won't deal with me fairly. I want his collection. And the only way I'll get access to it is if he's... out of the picture. Permanently. Do this, and you can have your pick of his soul gems.

description: Alvor's mine, the source of his best ore, has been overrun by a new nest of Frostbite Spiders. He can't work until they're cleared out. It's a dirty, dangerous job, perfect for a sellsword.
hook: Work's come to a standstill. Damn spiders have moved into the main shaft of the quarry. They're huge, and they're aggressive. My workers are too scared to go back in. You look like you know how to squash a bug. Go clear them out so we can get the ore flowing again.

description: Jarl Balgruuf's children were playing in Proventus Avenicci's quarters and found a rather... risqué statuette of Dibella. Proventus is mortified that the Jarl knows about it, and the Jarl wants it back just for the leverage. He wants you to 'find' it and return it to him, no questions asked.
hook: Proventus is a loyal steward. A bit... uptight. My children, however, are terrors. They found something in his quarters. A statuette of Dibella that is... anatomically enthusiastic. He's been blushing for a week. I'd like to have it in my possession. Just in case I ever need him to agree to a particularly large expenditure. Retrieve it for me. Discreetly.

output: {"Quest":{"Name":"The Bear of Markarth","Giver":"Ulfberth War-Bear","Actions":["goto Windhelm Slums","damage Galmar Stone-Fist"]}}
description: Before he settled down with Adrianne, Ulfberth had a famous rivalry with a young Stormcloak soldier named Galmar Stone-Fist. They had a legendary brawl that Ulfberth lost due to a cheap shot. He's never forgotten. He wants you to find Galmar in Windhelm and give him a scar to remember the name 'War-Bear.'
hook: You ever hear how I got the name War-Bear? It wasn't from my sunny disposition. There was a man, a brute named Galmar. We fought for a full day. He won because he threw dirt in my eyes. A coward's trick. He's Ulfric's right hand now, all high and mighty. Go to Windhelm. Find him. And give him a beating he'll feel in his bones. Tell him it's a belated gift from the War-Bear.
